programMetadata.trainingSplit: 4 true training days / 8 separate AM-PM sessions
programMetadata.hardSchedulingRule: On normal training days, the final exercise must be completed by 6:00 PM.

weekPlan.title: RE-ENTRY / ACCUMULATION — WEEK 1
weekPlan.rawRule: Use conservative starting loads. Main strength work generally around RPE 6–7. Re-establish technique. Learn current skill baselines. Do not test strength.

weekPlan.title: RE-ENTRY / ACCUMULATION — WEEK 2
weekPlan.rawRule: Progress through additional repetitions inside the prescribed ranges or a small load increase. Technique remains the priority.

weekPlan.title: RE-ENTRY / ACCUMULATION — WEEK 3
weekPlan.rawRule: Main strength work may reach approximately RPE 7–8. Still avoid repeated grinders and routine failure.

weekPlan.title: DELOAD
weekPlan.rawRule: Reduce normal resistance-training set volume approximately 30–40%. Keep loads technically meaningful but avoid hard efforts. Continue muscle-up, planche and handstand patterns with easier variations, fewer total sets, no maximal holds and no aggressive testing. Reduce jump contacts approximately 50% and treadmill acceleration volume approximately 50%.

weekPlan.title: BUILD
weekPlan.rawRule: Resume normal volume. Progress strength loads, hypertrophy reps/load, muscle-up assistance, pull height, planche lean, tuck-planche control, handstand independence, L-sit duration, HSPU quality, grip duration and acceleration exposure. Do not progress every variable at the same time.

weekPlan.title: CONSOLIDATION / TESTING
weekPlan.rawRule: Reduce unnecessary accessory fatigue. Assess bodyweight, waist, progress photos, available skinfold measurements, muscle-up progress, pulling, planche, handstand, HSPU, L-sit, grip, broad jump, vertical jump, acceleration quality and major strength movements without mandatory true 1RM grinding.

nonNegotiables: Eight separate AM/PM Lift Ghost sessions
Muscle-up exposure at least twice weekly
Planche exposure at least twice weekly
On normal training days, the final exercise must be completed by 6:00 PM.

missedAMMergeRules.rawRule: Never complete the entire missed AM workout immediately before the full PM workout. Perform only the listed priority work, then begin Day 1 PM.
Perform only the listed priority work, drop the listed additional work, then perform the normal PM workout.
Do not cram a complete athletic-power session into the lower-body workout.

priorityWork.rawPrescription: Prescribed source preparation; exact additional dose not separately specified in missed-AM section

missedAMMergeRules.rawRule: Perform only the listed priority work before Day 4 PM. Drop the remaining AM accessory skill work.

explosiveWork: Stop the power set if jump height clearly decreases.
Stop the power set if jump distance clearly decreases.
Stop the power set if landing becomes sloppy.
Stop the power set if bar speed clearly falls.
Stop the power set if movement becomes a grind.
Quality is more important than completing every prescribed repetition.
skillWork: Stop or regress when elbows bend unintentionally during planche work.
Stop or regress when scapular position collapses.
Stop or regress when muscle-up becomes uncontrolled.
Stop or regress when excessive kicking replaces pulling power.
Stop or regress when wrist, shoulder or elbow discomfort becomes more than normal training stress.
hypertrophyWork: Most hypertrophy work should finish with approximately 1–3 reps in reserve.

programRules.hypertrophyDoubleProgression: Stay at the same load until all prescribed sets can be performed near the upper end of the range while maintaining required RIR/RPE. Then increase the load modestly and rebuild through the range.
programRules.muscleUpProgressionRule: Do not reduce band assistance when doing so destroys movement quality.
programRules.planchePhaseRule: Phase 1 is foundation development. There is no requirement to reach advanced planche progressions immediately.

muscleUp: unassisted attempt only if technically ready
strength: major lifts without mandatory true 1RM grinding

skillPriorityRule.laterPhaseRule: Front Lever and Human Flag receive dedicated emphasis during later FREAK-GOD phases.
